about: A reader is what it emits over its vectors, never the bytes of its code or of the shell it imports.
An edit that emits the same over them keeps the reader's identity and every place it read; an edit that emits otherwise is another reader and reads again.
The runner of a package's tests is the same: what it reports over its vectors keys every block it kept, never the bytes of run.ts.
